decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed detached games room, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having regard for the characteristics of the site. The proposal would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, and would comply with the Council's parking standards in the interests of highway and pedestrian safety. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, T.1.4 and the Residential Extensions Guidelines (October 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the games room is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the information given in the submitted drawings, the external walls of the detached games room shall be finished in red/brown sand faced brickwork to match the adjacent ground floor rear extension or such other materials shall be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the permission is implemented.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeast wall of the games room hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached games room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 62 Thorncliffe Road. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
description: Erection of games room to dwellinghouse on site existing garage
